node.title: Track normalization degree and full fixed divisors along actual regular anchors
node.statement: Over a perfect field, while shared parent and child images are nonconstant, actual regular anchors obey D=nu*eta, eta>=s-1, nu_child=nu*mu and D_child=D-nu*m with eta=m+mu*eta_child and m>=the geometric branch count at the centre. Original dimension11 degree<=J-1 gives nu_0<=floor((J-1)/10); a larger final normalization degree forces an actual nonbirational anchor. No free anchor selection or affordable census is claimed.
